Name: Joab
Summary: Joab, son of Zeruiah, commanded David's army through all his wars. He won Jerusalem, killed Abner in revenge for Asahel, murdered Amasa to keep his command, and killed Absalom against David's order. David never removed him, but charged Solomon to deal with him.
KeyStory: Joab won David's wars and murdered David's rivals — loyal, ruthless, and finally condemned.
KeyVerses: 2 Samuel 2:13; 2 Samuel 3:27; 2 Samuel 8:16; 2 Samuel 18:14; 2 Samuel 20:10; Psalm 60:1
RelatedPeople: Zeruiah; Abishai; Asahel; King David; Abner, Son of Ner; Amasa, Son of Ithra
LifeLesson: A commander who kills for revenge and ambition will answer for it, however many battles he won.
